jinsei-game.notes: The standard 2008 sixth edition includes Junior and adult Millionaire stages. Scope is not every edition since 1968. Native layer and mixed-language OCR were unusable; Japanese-only fresh OCR is better but still imperfect. Original PDF governs. Specific scoring MAJOR recorded.

bailout-the-game.notes: Actual archived publisher setup page links complete original board-game directions. Separate card-game directions not substituted. Four pages, first three full rules; fresh forced English OCR. Specific final-settlement MAJOR recorded.

giocagoal.notes: Actual 200 HTML read. Collector confirms assembly/game-rule leaflet existed in June 1974 SuperGiocagoal SG01 package; page images are front/back packaging, not original leaflet. Local target is 1973 Atlantic half-field game; SuperGiocagoal full-field package equivalence is not assumed. No usable full rules recovered. Related Europe 1980 collector page remains a lead.

kampen-om-rai.notes: Designer-named contemporary event overview identifies two-player game, treasure-return objective and combat units. Book catalogue sources tie the game to Josefine Ottesens Drageherren, with base set/rules in first book and later sets/variants in later books. Fourth book Smykket provides solo variant, not base. First-book full original insert remains unfound. No catalogue summary or AI-generated overview accepted; no contacts/purchases.
